title: Localization and Abelianization of Strings on Group Manifolds: The Non-simply Connected Case
summary: We study the partition functions of Wess--Zumino--Witten (WZW) models with compact connected simple Lie group manifolds that are not simply connected. Starting from the modular-invariant partition function of Felder--Gawędzki--Kupiainen (FGK), we derive a localization formula, which can also be obtained directly by supersymmetric localization of the corresponding supersymmetric WZW model. Our results reveal a variety of topological effects associated with the nontrivial topology of the target group.
